existing_idea.mechanism: A real compiler may linearize a source table while inheriting a header over subsequent values. The existing proposal requires an independently bound schema and complete source rows, including empty cells; it does not authorize free field deletion or a guessed native table.

specific_unknown: What happened to written medical rubrics and their scopes when a tabular Tacuinum entry was presented as an illustrated prose caption? Did particular rubrics remain explicit, become genuinely recoverable from a fixed order, or disappear together with substantive field content? The mere existence of a table and an illustrated caption does not establish a lossless table-to-prose rule or direct copying between those two witnesses.

smallest_proposed_source_packet.tabular_side: BnF Latin6977, complete f6r table, including its full headings, every complete row, marginal/prose qualifications, and any continuation required to finish a row. The f6r locator comes from a public facsimile-description lead; its complete primary extent and foliation have not been collated here.
smallest_proposed_source_packet.prose_side: For the exact named items actually present in that fixed complete table, locate the corresponding complete entries in the already known Tacuinum witnesses: BnF Latin9333 via the MediManus diplomatic layer, or ULiège Ms1041 where original caption pages are accessible. Do not presume that the four previously viewed Liège entries coincide with f6r's rows. Do not select a row because it resembles Voynich.
smallest_proposed_source_packet.pairing_condition: Each paired item must be identified from its source-owned heading and complete content; preserve witness differences. Shared genre or a shared plant name alone does not prove the same source row or direct descent. If a complete exact pair cannot be established, report that narrow acquisition limit; do not invent a transformation.
smallest_proposed_source_packet.primary_task: Manually collate one complete table and its bounded corresponding prose entries. Mark, for every source field, its written heading, value, qualifiers, argument owner, order and any genuine empty cell. Distinguish omitted rubric with retained value, omitted value, substituted content, uncertain reading and reordered content.
smallest_proposed_source_packet.source_history: This would be source-only construction evidence. No historical source is identified as the Voynich exemplar, no target paragraph or word receives a value, and no native format is inferred from the external table.

difference_from_executed_887.executed_contract: Three fixed complete Lactuca/Piretrum/Apium records; ordinary source atoms mapped injectively to whole native groups, two global entity prefixes, grammatical et/in/cum implicit, and seven rubrics globally either all explicit or all implicit.
difference_from_executed_887.retained_outcome: Both declared compiler variants had no complete solution. All length-compatible assignments failed repeated ordinary-atom equality before joint entity reconstruction. No identity was predicted.
difference_from_executed_887.new_acquisition_question: An actual historical table/prose comparison could supply which omissions, surviving labels and scopes a historical writer really used. GDT887's binary rubric setting was a model assumption, not a collated conversion from Latin6977 to its source captions.
difference_from_executed_887.not_authorized_by_difference: A newly found omission pattern would not repair887, justify arbitrary aliases, or identify a target text. A genuinely different full source/writing contract would require its own scientific selection. No such contract is constructed here.

other_close_predecessors.limit: Already supplies the real Acharistum prose reference inheriting indications while changing ingredients. That is explicit backward field reference, not evidence of table-header suppression.
Already shows selective inheritance and whole-entry inheritance plus a fixed override can produce the same content. A new source story alone is not a discriminator.
Existing615/121 source-redaction limitations remain. No repeated MS617 access audit or new source montage is proposed.

prospective_decision_differences: If a complete source-owned comparison preserves all content through an actually attested fixed inherited-header rule,888 gains a concrete historical construction to consider. It still gains no native mapping or automatic test priority.
If prose instead writes the rubrics explicitly, a header-omission motivation from that pair is rejected; preserve the observed explicit record grammar rather than pretending it is omission.

If values or qualifiers are discarded, replaced or freely reordered, the pair is not a content-preserving row linearizer. Any redaction model must name and pay those different operations; no automatic broader compiler follows.
If witness correspondence, whole extent or reading remains uncertain, stop at the specific source acquisition limit. Do not infer absent evidence across the whole Tacuinum tradition.
